opening: I had a feeling that the room was spinning.
It came on suddenly, as I was going to bed.
The spinning made me feel nauseous several times.
I threw up several times because of it.
I have a history of eczema.

opening.text: I'm here because I had a feeling that the room was spinning. It came on suddenly as I was going to bed and lasted about 3 minutes. The spinning made me feel nauseous several times, and I threw up several times because of it. I also have a history of eczema.
